about_the_game:
Welcome to Heist Haven, a sprawling, dynamic criminal playground. Dive into an ever-evolving battle between Cops and Robbers in a high-octane, action-packed environment! Whether you’re enforcing the law or outsmarting it, Heist Haven lets you live both sides of the coin in a fresh take on the PvE Heist FPS experience.

  • Play as Cops or Robbers: Create, customise and level up separate Cop and Robber characters. Progress through the world and unlock new locations and missions.

  • Online PvE Co-op Gameplay: Team up with a crew of Robbers for cooperative heists, or join forces with fellow Cops to protect Heist Haven from the criminal underworld.

  • Vast Open World: Explore the massive, interactive city of Heist Haven. From towering skyscrapers to underground tunnels, vibrant neighborhoods to abandoned warehouses, every corner holds secrets, loot, and dangerous opportunities.

  • Dynamic Heists & Missions: Team up with friends or go solo to plan and execute high-stakes heists. Robbers need to plot their next big score while avoiding the police, while Cops must chase, negotiate, and eliminate these dangerous criminals.

  • Customizable Weapons & Vehicles: Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons, gadgets, and vehicles tailored to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear and develop unique strategies to outsmart your foes.

content_descriptors.notes: Heist Haven features frequent displays of criminal acts and violence. Players can steal from people and companies. Players can commit acts of violence, such as shooting weapons and hitting people vehicles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
